snippet.title: The Last Fireman Trailer
snippet.description:
One firefighter. Spreading flames. A ticking clock.

Watch the official trailer for The Last Fireman, a third-person arcade firefighting game where quick decisions matter as much as quick feet.

🔥 Get it on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608290/The_Last_Fireman/

Fight spreading fires, manage your extinguisher’s charge and dodge explosive hazards across five levels. Find faster routes, earn three stars and compete on Steam leaderboards—or tackle the entire campaign with one continuous stopwatch in Speed Run mode.

Grab your extinguisher. Make every second count.

Subscribe for more gameplay and updates from The Last Fireman.

#TheLastFireman #IndieGame #OfficialTrailer
